bands.label: Clean
bands.description: Normal, positive, or neutral chat (greetings, gg/glhf, casual talk)

bands.label: Gaming Slang (False Alarm)
bands.description: Contains trigger words ('kill', 'destroy', 'murdered that play') but non-hostile in context

bands.label: Ambiguous / Sarcastic
bands.description: Tone unclear without context; dry sarcasm, backhanded comments

bands.label: Subtle Hostility
bands.description: Passive-aggressive, mocking, condescension without explicit insults

bands.label: Severe/Extreme
bands.description: Slurs, threats, hate speech, extremist content, doxxing
